prompt:
Theme:
Translucent white under the evening moon

Subject:
Full-length vertical photograph of an adult woman standing in the center of a shallow rocky reef at dusk, wrapped from chest to feet in wet, translucent white fabric.

Person/Expression:
Quiet profile-leaning expression with the face tilted toward the bottom right of the screen and eyes cast down toward the hand holding the cloth. Slender oval contour, lowered elongated eyes, thin bridge of the nose, slightly parted pale lips. Wet dark brown shoulder-length hair is parted on the side, with thin strands clinging to cheeks and neck.

Clothing/Pose:
Thin white strapless long dress-like fabric wrapped from the chest, with diagonal drapes overlapping the torso and legs. Standing barefoot in the shallows, the person's own right hand lowered to the side, left hand pinching the fabric in front of the waist, and one leg stepped slightly forward.

Background/Light:
Thin crescent moon in the blue-purple sky in the upper left, orange sunset on the horizon to the right, sea surface and black rocks in the lower half. The low setting sun at the back right edges the wet cloth and body in gold, with soft blue twilight light from the front.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical composition, front-diagonal full-body photo with the camera placed slightly lower than the waist. The person is placed large in the center, the upper half contains the evening sky and crescent moon, and the bottom edge captures the wet hem and feet. Focus on the person and the translucent cloth, with the background slightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
Photorealistic live-action photograph. Precisely captures the thin cloth clinging to the skin when wet, fine water droplets, reflections on rocks and water surface, and the orange and blue-purple sunset gradations.

Negative:
Do not make the white cloth opaque; do not omit the crescent moon and sunset",
